duty_percent.description: Quantity text strictly between 0 and 100 percent, optional %; instantaneous high phase has no finite rise/fall.

frequency_hz.description: Quantity text in Hz/kHz/mHz, bare text Hz; 0.05–500000 Hz before current sample-step and phase constraints. No sampling/playback adjustment is implicit.

preconditions: ID names a current pulse-source, even in an incomplete drawing
Proposed shared high/low phases satisfy current sample step and all experiment constraints
effects: Updates experiment high_s/low_s for every ideal-square pulse-source; choosing one source ID does not make its timing independent
Preserves source voltage values, finite/sine definitions, sample step, playback speed and startup voltage
Ordinary undoable electrical/settings edit: running restarts from configured startup, paused stays stale; supports atomic edit.batch
Re-entering displayed timing preserves phase bits and history; normal command/actor revisions may advance
Equivalent quantity/time aliases normalize before retry matching; snapshots expose configured timing, not measured oscillation
Never shortens sample step or changes playback to make a frequency fit; invalid requests preserve all prior state

errors.when: Malformed/missing/extra/null fields, both/neither timing forms, invalid quantity/range, wrong kind or shared phases too short for current sampling
Source ID does not exist after parameter validation

completion.mode: immediate validated settings edit; ordinary initialization observed separately

detailed_schema.x-source-inventory: snapshot.pulse_timings entries with shared true/source_kind pulse-source; all such entries share snapshot.transient_settings high_s/low_s
x-timing-relations: Exactly one frequency_hz or period_s plus duty_percent
Both phases 1 µs–10 s and >= current transient_settings.step_s
For fraction=duty_percent/100, frequency <= minimum(fraction,1-fraction)/step_s; other setting bounds remain authoritative

checks: Shared clock discovery and direct frequency/period/percent input preserve sampling, playback and component definitions
Displayed timing reentry preserves phase bits, history and live state
Live NPN LED switches off at 12.5 ms and on at 50 ms for a 20 Hz/25-percent clock
Captured source and LED current agree with each interior phase and retain both sides of exact edges
Threshold measurement resolves a 12.5 ms high pulse; settings and recording save/reopen
Both ideal-square IDs share one clock in an incomplete drawing while finite-pulse definition remains unchanged
limits: Ideal-square timing is global; selecting one source does not give it independent timing
Configured duty and measured threshold timing remain separate
Existing models, kernels, output sampling, work limits and project format remain unchanged
No physical device or complete physical typing/focus/accessibility/visible-latency qualification
